text:
The current in a lamp connected on its own to the mains supply is 0.60A.
A table decoration has three of these lamps connected in parallel.
Which rating of fuse is suitable to protect this circuit?
A
0.2A
B
0.6A
C
1.0A
D
5.0A
subject: Physics
